answer: Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the dawn of a task receipt, and the terrace is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
